verdict.rationale: Bolna's docs explicitly describe BYOT (Bring Your Own Telephony) allowing connection of any standards-compliant SIP trunk instead of bundled Twilio/Plivo providers, with providers managed centrally under Settings → Integrations. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of SIP trunk setup working in practice, and no explicit mention of importing existing Twilio/Telnyx numbers specifically.
